title: Wave-optics gravitational wave lensing in modified gravity
efc_relevance: Probes propagation-level departures from GR via wave-optics GW lensing — a regime invisible to geometric-optics shear analyses. Provides a new and clean discriminator for EFC's perturbation-sector P3 prediction Σ > 1, and complements arXiv:2605.04154 (Phaedrus screening regime) at the propagation rather than static-screening level.
ledger_action: Add to Stage-IV Roadmap as GW-propagation discriminator; cross-reference framework:Horndeski-Deffayet2011 (Σ from luminal-Horndeski) and arXiv:2605.04154; required follow-up: explicit EFC prediction for the wave-optics lensing phase shift on cluster scales.
